test_objective: Check that you cannot create a subscription with an existing id

test_cases.name: 028_04_01 Create a subscription with an id known to the system
test_cases.doc: Check that you cannot create a subscription with an existing id
test_cases.when:
when {
    the SUT receives a Request from the client containing:
        URL set to '/ngsi-ld/v1/subscriptions/'
        method set to 'POST'
        Request Header['Content-Type'] set to 'application/ld+json' and
 payload defined in file: 'subscriptions/subscription-sample.jsonld'
}
